items.source: While the shared interfaces provide portability, each provider also offers specific features through provider-specific options classes (e.g., OpenAiAudioSpeechOptions, ElevenLabsSpeechOptions). These classes implement the TextToSpeechOptions interface while adding provider-specific capabilities.
items.translation: 虽然共享接口提供了可移植性，但每个提供商还通过特定于提供商的选项类（例如 OpenAiAudioSpeechOptions、ElevenLabsSpeechOptions）提供特定的功能。这些类在实现 TextToSpeechOptions 接口的同时，增加了特定于提供商的能力。

items.source: Spring AI provides a unified API for Text-To-Speech (TTS) through the TextToSpeechModel and StreamingTextToSpeechModel interfaces. This allows you to write portable code that works across different TTS providers.
items.translation: Spring AI 通过 TextToSpeechModel 和 StreamingTextToSpeechModel 接口为文本转语音（TTS）提供统一的 API。这允许您编写可在不同 TTS 提供商之间通用的可移植代码。

items.source: Depend on Interfaces: Always inject TextToSpeechModel rather than concrete implementations
items.translation: 依赖接口：始终注入 TextToSpeechModel 而非具体实现类

items.source: Use Common Options: Stick to TextToSpeechOptions interface methods for maximum portability
items.translation: 使用通用选项：坚持使用 TextToSpeechOptions 接口方法以获得最大的可移植性

items.source: One of the key benefits of the shared TTS interfaces is the ability to write code that works with any TTS provider without modification. The actual provider (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, etc.) is determined by your Spring Boot configuration, allowing you to switch providers without changing application code.
items.translation: 共享 TTS 接口的核心优势之一是能够编写无需修改即可适配任何 TTS 提供商的代码。实际的提供商（如 OpenAI、ElevenLabs 等）由您的 Spring Boot 配置决定，这让您可以在不更改应用程序代码的情况下切换提供商。
